summary: show running is the most expensive command on network devices and slows playbooks a lot, especially when repeated before and after changes.
questions: Why is my network playbook so slow?
Should I check the running config before and after changes?

answer_card.title: Avoid show running when possible
answer_card.answer_md: `show running` is the most resource-intensive command on a network device and slows playbooks significantly, especially on large devices. A playbook that checks running config, changes it, then checks again will be very slow. Only run it when you really need it.
